name: Crossbow
description: A compact crossbow, meticulously maintained and loaded with a single bolt. The wood is darkened with age, but the string is taut and the mechanism is clean. It looks effective, if only you had a clear shot.

params.message: The crossbow is surprisingly well-kept. A small tag reads: 'For emergencies only – one shot. Make it count.' The bolt is tipped with a dull, broad head.
You pick up the crossbow. It's heavier than it looks, but well-balanced.
You squeeze the trigger. The crossbow fires with a sharp *thwack*, but the bolt buries itself deep into the padded wall of the panic room. The weapon is now spent.
